Position Summary
The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager is responsible for leading the Company’s budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and business analysis activities. This role serves as a strategic business partner to executive leadership and operational stakeholders by delivering timely financial insights, supporting critical business decisions, and driving financial performance across the organization.
The FP&A Manager will develop financial plans, enhance reporting capabilities, and support the Company’s long-term strategic objectives. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical judgment, commercial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Financial Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting
• Lead the annual budgeting process, monthly/quarterly rolling forecasts, and long-range financial planning initiatives.

• Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting revenue, operating expenses, headcount, capital expenditures, cash flow, and profitability projections.

• Monitor financial performance against last year, budget and forecast, identifying key trends, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.

• Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decision-making and resource allocation.

• Coordinate planning activities across business functions to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and planning assumptions.

Financial Reporting and Analysis
• Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting packages.

• Analyze financial and operational results and provide clear explanations of key business drivers and variances.

• Develop, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

• Present financial results, outlooks, and recommendations to executive and senior leadership.

• Business Partnership and Strategic Support

• Partner with departmental leaders to evaluate business initiatives, investments, and operating strategies.

• Provide decision support related to hiring plans, capital investments, pricing, and expense management.

• Perform profitability, margin, customer, product, and cost analyses to improve financial performance.

Process Improvement and Financial Systems
• Identify and implement improvements to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes.

• Drive automation and standardization initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and data integrity.

• Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and operational teams to improve financial data quality and reporting capabilities.

• Maintain clear documentation of planning processes, methodologies, assumptions, and relevant controls.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Accounting to ensure consistency between actual results, forecasts, and financial reporting.

• Support month-end and quarter-end review processes through variance analysis and management reporting.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Lead or participate in special projects and ad hoc financial analyses requested by senior management

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field required.

• MBA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional certification preferred.

• Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience managing budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and management reporting processes.

• Experience partnering with business leaders and presenting financial information to senior management.

• Prior experience in SaaS, technology, fintech, financial services, or another high-growth environment preferred.

Technical Competencies
• Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario-analysis skills.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow analysis, unit economics, and performance management.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial data analysis.

• Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or comparable platforms.

• Experience with planning and business intelligence tools such as Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment, Vena, OneStream, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable solutions.

• Strong data visualization, reporting, and presentation capabilities.

Key Performance Indicators
• Performance may be evaluated using the following measures, as applicable to the organization:

• Forecast accuracy and reliability.

• Budget adherence and effectiveness of variance management.

• Timeliness, accuracy, and quality of management reporting.

• Effectiveness of business partnership and decision support.

• Process efficiency improvements, standardization, and automation achievements.

• Quality of analysis supporting strategic initiatives.

• Contribution to profitability, cost optimization, cash management, and organizational growth.

Leadership Expectations
• Demonstrate ownership and accountability for financial planning and reporting activities.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

• Promote collaboration, transparency, integrity, and operational excellence across the organization.

CA Pritam Mahure and Associates (PMA) is an award‑winning Chartered Accountancy firm recognized as a leader in GST and Indirect Taxes, supporting businesses in India and abroad with complex GST matters, disputes, and compliance. With a team of more than 50 members comprising of Chartered Accountants, consultants, and trained professionals, PMA combines technical tax expertise with practical business understanding.

PMA has trained tens of thousands of professionals and government officials on GST, authored leading GST publications, and regularly contributes to professional and industry forums in India and the Middle East. Its clientele includes listed companies, major consulting firms, start‑ups, and organizations across sectors such as real estate, manufacturing, pharma, IT, banking, hospitality, retail, agriculture, and energy.

Role Description You will support the team in delivering GST advisory, compliance, and litigation services as an on‑site internship role based in Pune City. Day‑to‑day responsibilities include assisting in GST return preparation and review, compiling and analyzing data for GST health checks, and supporting documentation for audits, investigations, and assessments. The trainee will help in drafting notes, working papers, and summaries on GST issues, and in researching relevant provisions, notifications, circulars, and case laws. The role also involves contributing to client presentations, internal knowledge material, and standard operating procedures, while coordinating with team members to ensure accurate and timely work delivery. The internship provides hands‑on exposure to diverse industries and real‑world GST applications under the guidance of experienced professionals.

Qualifications
• CA Inter Both Groups Passed.
• Sound understanding of basic accounting and taxation concepts, with a keen interest in GST and Indirect Taxes.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to handle data, prepare reports, and create structured documentation.
• Keen interest to use AI
• Ability to conduct structured legal and tax research, interpret statutes and case laws, and summarize findings clearly.
• Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a systematic approach to reviewing transactions and reconciliations.
• Stipend - INR 10,000 per month for first year. INR 14,000 per month from second year.

• Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
• Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
